race.comment: AWESOME LILY (2) disappointed two back before a 1.1L defeat over further last time out in a good return to form. O'Donnell remains in the irons and she's a winner at this track and trip previously. Can get back to winning ways. ODIN OMEN (4) was building toward his last start victory, running over the top to score by 1.1L in an impressive victory. Tsang reunites with the gelding and he looks to get every chance from the draw. Can put his best foot forward. FELLAFROMDOWNUNDER (3) stuck on well at Broome last start in a much better effort. Back in trip today is no issue and he can sit close to the speed again. Can go close if he runs up to recent form. CANDLELIGHT SHERIF (1) is racing in good order and won't be far away if he can hold his form. FORBIDDEN APPLE (7) is building into the campaign and can improve now third-up.
